title: Statistics on Age Discrimination Complaints Lodged with TAFEP and Sectors Most Frequently Implicated
what_it_is: Statistics on Age Discrimination Complaints Lodged with TAFEP and Sectors Most Frequently Implicated

sections.label: Age discrimination complaints and Workplace Fairness Bill
sections.summary: MOM and TAFEP received an annual average of 61 age discrimination complaints in 2023 and 2024, and a second Workplace Fairness Bill is planned.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) and the Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices (TAFEP) received an annual average of 61 complaints of age discrimination in 2023 and 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The top three sectors with the most number of complaints were administrative and support service activities; wholesale and retail trade; and accommodation and food service activities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In 2023 and 2024, TAFEP identified an annual average of 90 job advertisements containing words or phrases that were potentially discriminatory on the basis of age.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To further assist employers to better understand their obligations under the TGFEP and build merit-based and fair workplaces, TAFEP has also provided the employers with resources, such as guides and clinics.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We plan to table the second Workplace Fairness Bill in Parliament by the end of the year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: If passed, we intend to implement the Workplace Fairness Act sometime in 2026 or 2027.

sections.label: Age discrimination complaint averages
sections.summary: The average annual number of age discrimination complaints was about 77 from 2018 to 2022 and 61 from 2023 to 2024.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In fact, the average annual number of age discrimination complaints received was about 77 during the period from 2018 to 2022, as cited in the Tripartite Committee on Workplace Fairness Final Report, and 61 over the period 2023 to 2024, as I shared in this Parliamentary Question response.

sections.label: Emailing MOM and educational approach
sections.summary: Cases can be emailed to MOM, which will work with TAFEP to investigate, with emphasis on an educational approach.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Failing which, of course, you can always email directly to MOM and we will then work with TAFEP to investigate further.

And finally, what is the approach we are going to take for cases like this, I think our emphasis is always on taking a more educational approach to make sure that both employers and employees understand what are discriminatory practices in the workplace.

sections.label: Advertisement wording and educational approach
sections.summary: The choice of words in advertisements may not be well considered and can create misunderstanding, so an educational approach is hoped to prevent such occurrences.

sentences.text: But sometimes, the choice of words, the phrasing and the type of words they use in advertisements, for example, are probably not well considered enough, and that can create a misunderstanding and the impression.
So, with the educational approach, we hope that this will prevent more of such occurrences from taking place.
